source.from: EmailSum (Zhang et al., 2021): thread shape (3–10 mails) and short summaries keeping key facts; structure only

request: Summarize the emails about my Erasmus application.

mails.subject: Erasmus application received
mails.body:
Dear Tom,

We have received your Erasmus application for the spring semester at Nordhaven University. We will contact you if anything is missing.

Kind regards,
International Office

mails.subject: Erasmus learning agreement – missing signature page
mails.body:
Dear Tom,

Your learning agreement is missing the signed signature page. Please send it by Friday 20 November at the latest, otherwise your nomination cannot go ahead.

Kind regards,
International Office

mails.subject: Nomination and housing
mails.body:
Dear Tom,

Good news: Nordhaven University has accepted your nomination, pending the signature page. Their student housing applications open on Tuesday 1 December.

Kind regards,
International Office

mails.subject: International Week
mails.body:
Dear students,

International Week starts on 23 November, with a food fair and a photo contest.

International Office

mails.subject: pizza tonight?
mails.body: Hey Tom, pizza at 8 tonight? Maya
